title: Heritage: the Osiris Shaft as a living record
prefixes:
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#>
PREFIX x3do: <https://www.web3d.org/specifications/X3dOntology4.1#>
PREFIX twin: <https://example.org/scen/twin#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX crm: <http://www.cidoc-crm.org/cidoc-crm/>
PREFIX h: <https://example.org/scen/heritage/record#>
PREFIX sc: <https://example.org/scen/heritage/scene.ttl#>
PREFIX unit: <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/>

questions.title: Show everything whose only support is speculative
questions.why: The scene draws a Hall of Records; only the record says it is speculative. The query finds every drawn element whose attribution is speculative, so the picture can never pass a guess off as a find.

questions.title: Where do the sources disagree about a dimension, and by how much?
questions.why: Three accounts give three total depths. Linked as three measurements of one feature, the disagreement becomes a number the page can draw beside the shaft.

questions.title: What does the model draw against what the record measured?
questions.why: Only the X3D knows the drawn size; only the record knows the measured one. Joined, every documented dimension gets a drawn-versus-recorded check.
questions.sparql:
SELECT ?o ?label ?recorded ?drawn WHERE {
  ?m a crm:E16_Measurement ; crm:P39_measured ?thing ; crm:P40_observed_dimension ?d .
  ?d crm:P2_has_type ?axis ; crm:P90_has_value ?recorded .
  ?axis twin:axis ?ax .
  ?thing rdfs:label ?label ; crm:P138i_has_representation ?o .
  ?o x3do:hasChildren ?shape . ?shape x3do:hasGeometry ?box .
  ?box x3do:size ?boxL . ?boxL rdf:first ?boxsx ; rdf:rest ?boxR1 . ?boxR1 rdf:first ?boxsy ; rdf:rest/rdf:first ?boxsz .
  BIND(IF(?ax = 0, ?boxsx, ?boxsy) AS ?drawn)
} ORDER BY ?label

inference.title: Everything inside Level 2, or inside the whole shaft
inference.why: CIDOC-CRM's RDFS file does not declare P46 transitive, so a plain reasoner adds nothing here. One rule (a property path) makes part-of chains collapse, and a click on the shaft lights every part below it.

fault_text: Shaft A is drawn 12 m tall against the documented 9.62 m, and the Hall of Records has lost its attribution.
